crossRefs.note: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way…
of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of…
To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
As also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers…
“I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the…
but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…

translations.web: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
translations.bsb: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
translations.kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
translations.asv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
